positives.description: Correct-by-construction metamorphic candidate using a different window width. The oracle must accept it across the complete support of PR #842's arb_msm_size strategy.

negatives.description: Adds one base to the correct MSM result only at n = 8104, Zakura's highest Booth-window transition below ProductionRank. EXPECTED TO ESCAPE: PR #842's bounded branch stops at 128 and its larger-size branch generates only powers of two plus or minus one, so 8104 is outside the strategy's support.

Adds one base to the correct MSM result at ProductionRank's n = 8192. The oracle must catch this positive-control mutant because 8192 is in the strategy support and is reached by the end-to-end prover.
